To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the protic ionic liquid [2-MPyH][OTf] is a promising catalyst for acid-catalyze reactions.
the acidity order of the ionic liquids was determined by Hammett method, and [2-MPyH][OTf] was found to be the most acidic one among these ionic liquids.
three new protic 2-methyl pyridinium-based ionic liquids were synthesized and characterized.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design and synthesis of new pyridinium-based ionic liquids and their catalytic performances for acid catalytic reactions.
the synthesis, acidity determination and catalytic activities of three novel protic pyridinium ILs.
the synthesis of protic ionic liquid catalysts based on the 2-methyl pyridinium cation and their performances for some acid-catalyze reactions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the acidity of protic ionic liquid can be tuned by the counteranion, and the protic ionic acid with the highest acidity is the most active catalyst for the acid-catalytic reactions.
protic pyridinium-based ionic liquids are good catalysts and the acidity order is [2-MPyH][HSO4] > [2-MPy][OTf] > [2-PyH][HSO3CF3] > [2-Pr2PyH][HS04].
2-methyl pyridinium trifluormethanesulfonates ([2-MPy]OTf) can be used as an efficient catalyst in acid-catalyze reactions.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the 2-methyl group of pyridinium is a good substituent in the design of protic ionic liquid for acid catalysis.
the protic pyridinium-based ionic liquids are promising catalysts for acid-catalyze reactions and their catalytic activities can be easily tuned by changing the anion.

the acidity of the ionic liquids is the most important factor to determine their catalytic activities for acid-catalyze reaction, and the acidity order of the ionic liquid is [2-MPyH][OTf] > [2-MPy][HSO4] > [2-HPy][HSO4].
The main takeaway from our work is that
protic pyridinium ILs can be used as effective and environmentally friendly catalysts for the esterification reactions of olefins with carboxylic acids.
the acidity of 2-MPyH-based ionic liquids is comparable to that of conventional mineral acids.
the acidity of protic ionic liquid catalysts is not necessarily correlated with their ability to catalyze acid-catalyze reactions.
